30 Rock
programme.desc: Comedy writer Liz Lemon's world turns upside down when brash network exec Jack Donaghy interferes with her show & instructs her to hire unpredictable movie star Tracy Jordan.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: The Girlie Show crew are sceptical of Tracy Jordan joining the cast, especially when the show becomes TGS with Tracy Jordan. Feeling blamed, Liz & Tracy throw a party.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Confident he can fix Liz's sketch show & love life, overbearing boss Jack sets her up on a blind date with his friend Thomas. Meanwhile, Jack infiltrates the writers' poker game.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Kenneth learns working for Tracy is more than he bargained for. Liz struggles to keep egomaniacal Jack out of the writers' room & scantily clad Cerie in her clothes.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: After being pressured by Jack to plug GE products in her show, Liz integrates him into a sketch.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Jack fears Liz is leading a life of mediocrity and appoints himself her mentor. Meanwhile, Liz needs to deal with a physically altered cast member.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Jack bumps Jenna's Late Night With Conan O'Brien spot by booking Tracy. Still irate over the show becoming TGS With Tracy Jordan, Jenna lashes out at Liz.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Fed up with her boorish boyfriend Dennis, Liz sends him packing & hits the New York singles scene under Jenna's guidance. Meanwhile, Jack has his own relationship woes.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: When clueless receptionist Cerie announces her engagement to a wealthy heir, Liz contemplates her own marital & maternal future while Jack crumbles under his mummy issues.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: After the entire cast binges on questionable seafood at the craft services table, they hunker down to pull an all nighter on Valentine's Day & cobble a new show together.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Realising she has to be more lenient with her staff, Liz adopts a more lax leadership style. Meanwhile, Jack takes Tracy along to an exclusive GE charity golf event.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Liz tries to keep Josh from jumping to a rival show. Tracy awards Kenneth a spot in his entourage. Jenna gets into hot water over a misquote in a magazine.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Jack persuades Ghostface Killah & producer Ridikolus to endorse Donaghy Estates. Meanwhile, Kenneth catches the eye of Ridikolus' girlfriend.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Jack helps his unlucky brother Eddie with a job, but can the crew handle two Donaghys? Liz makes staff cutbacks & everyone tries to please her to avoid the axe.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Threatened by a sneaky West Coast NBC executive, Jack enlists Kenneth to help thwart any attempts to usurp Donaghy's TV throne. Meanwhile, Tracy is served with paternity papers.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Liz is actually happy in her new relationship with Floyd, while Jack finds his job may be in jeopardy.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Floyd contemplates a move to the Midwest and asks Liz if she'd consider leaving TGS behind. Jack rushes to Paris - and soon, the altar - with Christie's auctioneer Phoebe.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Liz enlists Kenneth's help locating Tracy while dealing with her long distance relationship with Floyd. Jack's impending marriage to Phoebe brings his mum to town.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Jack launches his plan for SeinfeldVision. Meanwhile, Jenna adjusts to her weight gain after doing a pizza themed musical.

programme.desc: Always up for competition, Jack goes to a dinner where Devin and Don are & gets invited to Don's house. Meanwhile, Jack & Jenna lay into Liz about getting her life together.

programme.desc: To prevent GE digging up dirt on him, Jack hires his own private investigator. Tracy's wife Angie announces she will be with him at all times to make sure he behaves.

programme.desc: When Liz meets her idol Rosemary Howard, she invites her to guest write on the show. However, Rosemary's radical ideas that Liz grew up admiring are now too controversial.

programme.title: Bangkok Dangerous
programme.desc: Kong, a deaf-mute assassin, lives a life of quiet desperation working for Bangkok mobsters. Despite his disability, Kong's mentor, Jo, trains him to be an unfeeling killing machine.

programme.title: Demonic Toys 2
programme.desc: A group of people on a world wide search for oddities find themselves trapped in a nine hundred year old Italian castle when they accidently unleash the Demonic Toys.

programme.title: Pusher 3
programme.desc: This bloody and utterly captivating film completes Danish director Nicolas Winding Refn's crime trilogy. Copenhagen's biggest king pin must rethink his status when a younger crowd rolls in.

programme.title: Eyes Without A Face (Les Yeux Sans Visag
programme.desc: A surgeon causes a car accident which leaves his daughter disfigured and goes to extreme lengths to give her a new face.

programme.title: Super Mario Bros.
programme.desc: Two Brooklyn plumbers, Mario and Luigi, must travel to another dimension to rescue a princess from the evil dictator King Koopa and stop him from taking over the world.

programme.title: The Man Who Killed Don Quixote
programme.desc: Toby, a cynical advertising director, finds himself trapped in the outrageous delusions of an old Spanish shoe-maker who believes himself to be Don Quixote.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A story told both forwards and backwards in time about an ex- insurance investigator, unable to remember new thoughts, who uses notes and tattoos to hunt for the man he thinks killed his wife.

programme.title: I Saw The Devil
programme.desc: The line between good and evil begins to blur when a special agent goes on the hunt for a serial killer who brutally murdered his pregnant fiancee.

programme.title: The Paper Tigers
programme.desc: Three Kung Fu prodigies have grown into washed-up, middle-aged men. But when their master is murdered, they must juggle their dead-end jobs, dad duties, and old grudges to avenge his death.

programme.title: The Wrestler
programme.desc: A washed-up wrestler is forced to retire after a heart attack. His quest for a normal life is an unrelenting struggle.

programme.title: God Is A Bullet
programme.desc: After his ex-wife is murdered and his daughter is kidnapped by a cult, Bob Hightower, infiltrates the group to hunt down their leader with the help of the cult's only female victim escapee.

programme.title: Timecrimes
programme.desc: A man accidentally gets into a time machine and travels back in time nearly an hour. Finding himself will be the first of a series of disasters of unforeseeable consequences.

programme.title: Hellraiser III: Hell On Earth
programme.desc: J.P., a womanising nightclub owner, buys a bizarre, abstract pillar at a mysterious art gallery. Unknowingly, he's purchased the gateway to hell.

programme.title: Hellraiser 4: Bloodline
programme.desc: In the 22nd century, a scientist tries to fix the wrong his ancestor caused: the puzzle box that opens the gates of Hell and unleashes Pinhead and his Cenobite legions.

programme.title: Deliver Us
programme.desc: When a nun in a remote convent claims immaculate conception, a team of priests investigate, concerned that the woman will give birth to twin boys: one the Messiah, the other the Anti-Christ.

programme.title: The Hitcher
programme.desc: A young man who escapes the clutches of a murderous hitchhiker is subsequently stalked by the hitcher and framed for his crimes.

programme.title: Caligula: The Ultimate Cut
programme.desc: Excess, violence and corruption mark the notorious emperor's reign in first-century Rome.

programme.title: Showgirls
programme.desc: Nomi Malone has what it takes to make it as a Las Vegas showgirl - what she doesn't have is a way in. To survive, she accepts the only job available, lap dancing at a seedy club.

programme.title: Blue Is The Warmest Colour
programme.desc: Adele's life is changed when she meets Emma, a young woman with blue hair, who allows her to discover desire and assert herself as a woman and adult. Adele grows and ultimately finds herself through love and loss.

programme.title: Dust Devil
programme.desc: A woman on the run from her abusive husband encounters a mysterious hitch-hiker.

programme.title: Eaten Alive
programme.desc: Psychotic redneck Judd owns a dilapidated hotel in rural Texas, where he murders people and then feeds their remains to his large pet crocodile in the swamp beside his hotel.

programme.title: Police Story
programme.desc: A kung-fu policeman (Jackie Chan) must protect a female witness (Brigitte Lin) from a Hong Kong drug lord for whom she used to work.

programme.title: District 13
programme.desc: Captain Damien must team up with Leito, a local insurgent from District 13, to defuse a neutron bomb that has fallen into the hands of a local drug lord, Taha, and rescue Leito's sister Lola.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: As the seconds tick down to midnight, an ex-con becomes a reluctant hero trapped by a masked "Collector" in a maze of lethal invention while trying to rescue the very family he came to rob.

programme.title: The Last Stop In Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a travelling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune.

programme.title: Sound Of Silence
programme.desc: Emma must uncover the dark secret behind a cursed radio to survive and protect her family.

programme.title: All Hallows' Eve (2013)
programme.desc: On Halloween, a babysitter finds an old VHS tape in the kids' trick or treat bag. The tape features three tales of terror, all linked together by a murderous clown. As the night goes on strange things begin to occur.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: A suburban dwelling man looking for some change and excitement becomes a corporate spy, but after meeting a mysterious woman he begins to question everything.

programme.title: Hokuriku Proxy War
programme.desc: A Yakuza group from Osaka with dreams of national dominance moves into the snowy Hokuriku region, sparking a bloody turf war with local gangs.

programme.title: Abre Los Ojos
programme.desc: A very handsome gentleman finds the love of his life, but suffers an accident and needs to have his face reconstructed through surgery after being severely disfigured.

programme.title: Vesper
programme.desc: Struggling to survive with her father after the collapse of Earth's ecosystem, 13-year-old Vesper must use her wits, strength and bio-hacking abilities to fight for the future.

programme.title: Cops Vs Thugs
programme.desc: A dirty cop is forced to choose between the police and his yakuza buddies when a new boss arrives in his precinct.

programme.title: Night Of The Living Dead (1968)
programme.desc: The radiation from a fallen satellite causes the recently deceased to rise from the grave and seek the living to use as food.

programme.title: Society
programme.desc: A Beverly Hills teen discovers his parents are part of a gruesome orgy cult for the social elite.

programme.title: The Navigator: A Medieval Odyssey
programme.desc: A young 14th Century boy with acute psychic powers believes that he can rescue his fellow villagers by tunnelling their way through the earth. To their surprise they come out in New Zealand in 1988.

programme.title: Police Story 2
programme.desc: A Hong Kong cop's unusual policing methods result in his demotion to traffic duty, despite his success in fighting crime. Meanwhile, an old enemy is released from prison and sets out to get revenge.

programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: A mysterious woman on the run, and the resourceful fixer assigned to bring her in. Their two unique stories inextricably link, as the stakes of the pursuit rise to apocalyptic proportions.

programme.title: Lords Of Chaos
programme.desc: The origins of Norwegian Black Metal and a group of young men with a flair for publicity, church-burning...and murder.

programme.title: Crabs!
programme.desc: In the middle of prom night, a swarm of murderous crabs descends upon a small coastal town.

programme.title: Final Cut
programme.desc: Life imitates art when the cast and crew of a low-budget zombie flick start to turn into the living dead.

programme.title: Dark Diamond
programme.desc: After his father's death, a man vows vengeance against the relatives who abandoned him.

programme.title: Possession
programme.desc: A woman starts exhibiting increasingly disturbing behaviour after asking her husband for a divorce. Suspicions of infidelity soon give way to something much more sinister.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: After a car crash, a TV director enters a subculture where collisions fuel sexual desire. Crash explores the erotic pull of danger, death, and the human urge to eroticize trauma.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: China. Chen Wing Yan, a young police officer, has been sent undercover as a mole in the local mafia. Lau Kin Ming, a young mafia member, infiltrates the police force.

programme.title: Project Wolf Hunting
programme.desc: (South Korea) When dangerous criminals on a cargo ship are transported from the Philippines to South Korea, they unleash a sinister force after an escape attempt leads to a riot. (Subtitles)

programme.title: The Toxic Avenger
programme.desc: In Tromaville, the toxic waste capital of America, a bullied janitor in a popular gym falls into a vat of toxic waste. He then turns into a super strong disfigured man.

programme.title: Re-Animator
programme.desc: A medical student (Jeffrey Combs) brings his headless professor back from the dead with a special serum.

programme.title: Corrective Measures
programme.desc: When a powerless new inmate arrives at a prison for supervillains, he must choose his friends wisely, or become a pawn in the deadly game between the Warden and the world's greatest criminal mastermind, The Lobe.

programme.title: Police Story 3: Super Cop
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective teams up with his female Red Chinese counterpart to stop a Chinese drug czar.

programme.title: Slumdog Millionaire
programme.desc: A young orphan from the slums of Mumbai, who is one question away from the Who Wants To Be A Millionaire jackpot, is arrested on suspicion of cheating.

programme.title: Sator
programme.desc: Secluded in a desolate forest, a broken family is observed by the demon Sator who is attempting to claim them.

programme.title: Memento
